name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a family legacy or racing dreams, but through a deep fascination with precision engineering. He started his career in the aviation industry, meticulously inspecting aircraft components before a chance encounter with a former Formula 1 engineer led him to ART Grand Prix. Dimitri quickly adapted his rigorous standards to the world of racing, becoming a linchpin in ensuring the team's vehicles meet the highest performance and safety benchmarks.

His approach to quality control is unrelenting. Dimitri believes that success lies in the details, and he's known for his sharp eye and refusal to compromise on standards. He's not afraid to challenge established procedures, constantly seeking ways to improve the team's processes and eliminate potential flaws before they impact performance on the track. His colleagues often describe him as demanding, but they also recognize the invaluable contribution he makes to the team's success. Dimitri's unique blend of aviation precision and racing passion makes him a highly respected, if somewhat feared, figure in the ART Grand Prix garage.

physical.description: Dimitri is a stocky man with a focused gaze that misses nothing.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to inspect parts.
Insists on using a specific brand of Russian tea during crucial inspections.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, which can be unnerving.
